title: Lesson Calendar - Right Menu - Draft Lesson - Publish Lesson Item - Visible
description: AC 01.1 - Decision Table - Draft lesson shows Publish Lesson action in the right-side calendar menu.
preconditions: - Logged in as HQ or CM Staff on Salesforce calendar.\n- A lesson with status Draft exists on calendar day view.
steps_actions: 1. Open Lesson Calendar and select a Draft lesson card.\n2. Open the right-side lesson menu actions.
steps_result: 1. Lesson detail side menu opens for the selected lesson.\n2. Publish Lesson action is visible in the menu.
suite: Publish Lesson Menu in Lesson Calendar
